description: Convert a time between time zones with daylight saving applied (you cannot do this reliably yourself). from/to accept IANA zones (Africa/Johannesburg), common abbreviations (SAST, EST, PST, GMT, CET, IST=India, CST=US Central) or big cities. Omit time for now. Returns each local date, time, UTC offset, abbreviation, hour difference and whether it is the next/previous day.

time.description: e.g. 2026-12-25 09:00, 14:30 or 2:30pm (today in from); omit for now

name: convert_timezone
